install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The repo ships no Dockerfile or compose file at all (a plain PHP app meant to be deployed onto an existing PHP+webserver stack, not containerized upstream). Used the project's own official image (linuxserver/grocy) via Docker Hub instead of lscr.io (that registry is denied by this sandbox's egress policy - 403 Forbidden - but the identical image is mirrored to Docker Hub under the same linuxserver/grocy name, so no functional change). Two real fixes needed: (1) this sandbox's Docker network has no IPv6 stack, so the image's default nginx site config (which unconditionally listens on [::]:80/443) crash-looped with 'socket() [::]:80 failed (97: Address family not supported by protocol)' - added a custom-cont-init.d/10-disable-ipv6-listen.sh script (the image's own supported hook mechanism) that strips the IPv6 listen lines from /config/nginx/site-confs/default.conf on every start, so the IPv4 listener still works normally. (2) grocy's own default admin account (admin/admin) doesn't match this pipeline's standard test credentials, so the crawler's login attempt failed with 'Invalid credentials' - logged in once as admin/admin and reset the account's username/password to the pipeline's standard libwalker/Walker-Pass-2026! via grocy's own user-edit page, letting the standard screens.py crawler log in and complete a full, unmodified 15/15 screen walkthrough on its own.
